mechanism_of_action: Liver-targeted antisense oligonucleotide against PNPLA3 mRNA.
efficacy_outcome: At week 12, placebo-corrected least-square mean changes in hepatic steatosis were −7.6% with 25 mg and −12.2% with 50 mg. At 80 mg, liver PNPLA3 mRNA knockdown was 89%; the abstract also reports reduced protein levels.
safety_signal: Generally well tolerated, with no adverse events leading to discontinuation or treatment-related serious adverse events.
